speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I need to examine your skin lesions to assess for potential malignancy. How long have you had these spots, and have they changed in size, shape, or color recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that detailed history; the combination of a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the penile shaft in a 62-year-old heavy smoker is highly concerning for squamous cell carcinoma. You also mentioned a similar lesion on your left middle finger—how would you describe that one in terms of size, pain, or any bleeding?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, CRP, CBC_Differential
